plan.scope: Owner 2026-11-05 authorizes exactly CAP-BOOK-EXCHANGE-001 in docs/pilots/parallel-20261105.md. New independent capability from canonical main 0710e51; historical migration hints are superseded. Preserve prior source, accounting engine, persistent storage/schema, auth/security and all reports. No tax rules or estimates. Follow mapped governance. Do not edit progress; Foundry appends it. Tier 2; model Claude CLI default subscription. No native/build/test commands from provider. Coordinator runs validation. No other Stories or agents.

stories.purpose: Create the sole versioned bookkeeping-to-tax exchange v1 JSON schema, synthetic example fixture, TS validator/serializer and meaningful automated tests. Read the approved pilot document. Expose a lossless serialized record with schemaVersion=1, product LLCBookKeepingPrivate, basis cash, currency USD, source business ID/name and source reference, period fromDate/throughDate, reviewStatus unreviewed, and incomeCents/expenseCents/netIncomeCents decimal integer strings copied exactly from an existing CashBasisReport; never recompute journal totals, allocate or classify tax. Explicit limitations: book figures only, not a tax return or deductibility/tax-basis determination; no sync/import implemented. Support negative book totals without floating-point coercion. Fail closed on unknown versions, malformed/leap-day dates, reversed period, unsupported currency, invalid cents (including unsafe numeric input), missing/invalid source/review status or mismatched report period; reject extra unknown schema fields to avoid silently losing semantics. Export typed APIs usable by the next UI Story; use existing report date validator if sufficient, strengthen only the new module otherwise. Fixture must clearly be synthetic. Tests validate fixture parity and roundtrip >MAX_SAFE_INTEGER strings, boundaries and malformed inputs; do not test source strings. Do not modify package manifests, existing domain/storage or report calculation code.

Integrate the existing v1 exchange serializer into a bounded Reports Bookkeeping exchange section. Use a new BookkeepingExchangePanel component with meaningful component tests via existing react-dom/server and React Native mocks (no new dependencies). Reports passes current source/business + existing computed report, requested dates, loading/error state and a JSON share callback. Never fetch or mutate ledger in the panel. Show source, period, cash basis, unreviewed/review needed, amounts and exclusions; missing data, bad dates, mismatched/stale report period or report failure disable export with a clear explanation. Explicit button Prepare bookkeeping JSON (accessibilityLabel same) invokes only the validated payload. Use explicit OS share action with application/json via existing expo File/Paths and Sharing patterns, handle errors and cancellation honestly (prepared/share-sheet opened, not delivered/sent). Preserve existing CSV/PDF/report flows. No tax calculations, import, sync, persistence/security changes. Minimum 48 native target for new buttons using existing Button. Add component tests for valid/empty/error/stale/loading states, exact payload callback/disabled behavior. Keep the new report section title Bookkeeping exchange and control label Exchange so the dedicated native test can find it. Coordinator native evidence at .foundry-host/parallel-pilot-20261105/native/<source SHA>/ in the Foundry root must be inspected during review; no physical-device or assistive-tech pass inferred.
